## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 106 captures during April 2024. This represents the site’s activity for the month and provides the basis for the subsequent image-quality and grading review. The capture total was reviewed alongside the number of images that could not be assessed and the grading outcomes reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 106 captures, 2 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.9. These images could not be included in the grading assessment. The result is reported separately so that the overall grading figures can be understood in the context of image quality at the site.

## Grading

Grading identified 18 referable results from the captures assessed. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates that half of the graded captures were completed within 1 day and half took at least 1 day. No new equipment faults were raised at the site during April 2024.
